result.summary: This residential intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and traffic control signs. While the low-density setting may imply lower traffic volumes, the presence of visual obstructions from vegetation and the absence of designated crossing points create a hazardous environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Intersection
hazards.description: There are no stop signs or traffic signals visible to control the flow of vehicles at this junction.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation on the right corner obscures sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers turning into or out of the side street.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted markings define a safe crossing path for pedestrians across either street.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The side street surface is cracked and uneven, which could pose a tripping hazard.

interventions.title: Install Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: High-visibility continental crosswalk markings should be added to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Traffic Control Signage
interventions.description: Install stop signs on the side street approach to regulate vehicle movement and improve safety at the conflict point.

interventions.title: Corner Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim or remove dense vegetation at the corner to improve visibility between all road users.
